```js
'use strict';

const STATUS_CODES = Object.freeze({
  100: 'Continue',
  ...
});

const DEFAULT_REASON = 'Unknown Status Code';

function getReasonPhrase(code) {
  const numeric = Number(code);
  return Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(STATUS_CODES, numeric)
    ? STATUS_CODES[numeric]
    : DEFAULT_REASON;
}

function isStatusCode(code) {
  return Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(STATUS_CODES, Number(code));
}

module.exports = { STATUS_CODES, getReasonPhrase, isStatusCode };
```
